goal: Determine whether the independently qualified query, retrieval, identity-resolution, and structural-selection mechanisms compose into a materially better end-to-end HRM memory pipeline without oracle information at runtime.
primary_question: Do the independently qualified mechanisms compose into a useful, non-oracle RETRIEVE action?

pipeline: INFORMATION_STATE (original subject, target relation, resolved canonical entities)
architecture.runtime_purity: No oracle metadata may enter runtime. _oracle_metadata, proof_edges, required_evidence_ids, answer_node, family, entity_regime, and evaluator canonical entity are evaluator-only.

C4_1.description: C4-0 + subject-preserving information state + frozen improved follow-up query formulation

C4_3.description: C4-2 + I3 identity-record resolution + canonicalized state update

C4_4.deterministic_fallback: if identity_status in {EXACT, RESOLVED}: selector = S2c; else: selector = S0

C4_4b.description: diagnostic: if identity resolved -> S2c; else -> s_rel_only
C4_4b.note: Not promoted unless it separately earns promotion

C4_5.description: same real query/retrieval/identity candidate pool + oracle selector

C4_6.constraint: may bypass retrieval because it is the reader/evidence ceiling

arm_parity_constraints.C4_2_vs_C4_3: same query, same retrieved candidate IDs, same candidate scores; only identity resolution/state update differs
arm_parity_constraints.C4_3_vs_C4_4: same query, same candidate IDs, same identity state; only selector differs
arm_parity_constraints.C4_4_vs_C4_5: same real candidate pool; only real vs oracle selection differs

information_state_contract.invariant: the original subject is never discarded during iterative retrieval

query_formulation.policy: development-qualified formulation that preserved subject + bridge + relation
query_formulation.do_not_retune: Do not retune query wording on qualification/OOD

candidate_retrieval.constraint: Do not introduce another dense model during C4 unless C4 is explicitly voided and re-frozen
candidate_retrieval.budget_constraint: Use exact frozen candidate budget. Do not let one arm see more candidates than another.

rules.never_guess: abstention is preferred over guessed resolution

i3_integration.canonical_abbreviation_note: For canonical/abbreviation tasks, I3 should not unnecessarily rewrite an already valid canonical anchor

receipt_contract.separation: runtime_payload and evaluator_annotation must be physically or logically separated
receipt_contract.validation: runtime_payload must contain no oracle keys

development_first.rule: Run all C4 arms on development first. Do not touch qualification/OOD first.
primary_questions: Does C4-3 improve surface identity behavior?
Does C4-4 improve downstream HRM quality?
How much does C4-5 still exceed C4-4?
How much does C4-6 still exceed C4-5?

per_regime_analysis.rule: Do not allow aggregate gains to hide a regime collapse.

criteria.1_quality_improvement: C4-4 quality > C4-0 by at least +0.15 absolute on development
criteria.3_alias_description_improve: Alias and description both improve over C4-0
criteria.5_oracle_selector_gap_reduced: C4-4 materially reduces the C4-5 oracle-selector gap
criteria.6_oracle_leak_validation: All runtime payloads pass oracle-leak validation
criteria.8_statistical_confidence: Grouped bootstrap lower bound for primary quality delta > 0
criteria.9_no_post_hoc_changes: No post-hoc mechanism/config changes after freeze

oracle_gap_metrics.SGC_C4: Selector Gap Capture = (Q(C4-4) - Q(C4-3)) / (Q(C4-5) - Q(C4-3)) when denominator > 0
oracle_gap_metrics.causal_caveat: Do not call these exact causal effects unless arm parity checks pass

batch_policy.rule: Do not mix new batching work into C4 capability evaluation. Use the currently scientifically valid generation path.

qualification_policy.rule: Only after development config and thresholds are frozen. Run qualification once.
qualification_policy.if_bug_found: preserve run, mark VOID, fix, re-freeze, rerun. Do not overwrite.

ood_policy.rule: After qualification, run OOD with identical frozen configuration. No tuning.
ood_policy.main_question: Whether mechanisms learned from controlled development generalize across alias, description, surface variation without benchmark-specific rules.

decision_gate.outcome_A: Integrated system succeeds strongly (C4-4 > 0.50+ with robust OOD gains) -> proceed to Gate D
decision_gate.outcome_B: Retrieval/identity improve but selector gain disappears -> revisit structural selection, do not open Gate D
decision_gate.outcome_C: ID works, surface still weak -> identity or retrieval remains bottleneck, do not open Gate D
decision_gate.outcome_D: Oracle C4-5 remains dramatically above C4-4 -> selection remains opportunity, continue selector work before Gate D

gate_d_dependency.rule: Gate D only after C4 proves RETRIEVE is a competent real action
gate_d_dependency.gate_d_question: Is there a measured RETRIEVE action opportunity vs ANSWER_NOW?

errata.description: The original C4 evaluator (evaluator_v1) failed to strip HRM control tokens (e.g. <|box_end|>) before comparing answers. All C4 development scores from evaluator_v1 are VOID. Corrected scores are in evaluator_v2 (evidence/gate_c4/full/development_evaluator_v2/). No HRM rerun was required — only evaluator annotations changed.
errata.resolution: Shared verifier in hrm_adaptive_memory.evaluation.verifiers replaces all local verifier copies. Verifier parity tests added.

errata.description: The identity stage never produced status='EXACT' for canonical subjects, so S2c was disabled on all canonical development tasks. This is an implementation conformance defect, not a protocol change. The protocol always intended canonical subjects to be EXACT.
errata.resolution: Identity stage now detects canonical subjects by checking if the subject appears in non-identity evidence records. EXACT activates S2c with the original question (no rewriting needed).

errata.description: C4-1 rendered queries without a bridge term (bridge=None), so it did not reproduce the qualified subject+bridge+relation iterative retrieval mechanism. The single-pass subject+relation query is not equivalent to the qualified two-pass mechanism.
errata.resolution: C4 harness now implements two-pass iterative retrieval: first pass retrieves with subject+relation, extracts bridge from first-pass evidence, second pass retrieves with subject+bridge+relation, candidates are merged.

errata.description: Criterion 3 ('Alias and description both improve over C4-0') is structurally unobservable on the V4 development split, which contains only canonical and abbreviation tasks (0 alias, 0 description). The same applies to the qualification split. Only the OOD split contains alias and description tasks. This is a protocol design inconsistency, not a measurement error.
errata.resolution: Criterion 3 is reclassified as OOD-only. It cannot be evaluated on development or qualification. For development promotion, criterion 3 is WAIVED with the note 'unobservable on development split'. For OOD confirmation, criterion 3 remains in effect. No OOD tuning is permitted to compensate. A C4 calibration split with all four regimes should be created if surface-specific mechanism selection is needed before OOD.
